test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.**

Eight years ago, she founded / Humans of Bombay, inspired of / the single idea - we all want to be heard.

options.text: the single idea - we all want to be heard.

solution:
Here, the erroneous part is** "****Humans of Bombay, inspired of."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The error lies in the part **"Humans of Bombay, inspired of."**
 
• The sentence has a minor error in the use of the preposition.
 
• It should be **"inspired by"** instead of** "inspired of."**
 
• The reason for using **"by"** is that it correctly indicates the source of inspiration.
 
• In this context, the inspiration comes from the single idea that **"we all want to be heard."**
 
• Therefore, the founder was inspired by (meaning** "because of"** or** "as a result of"**) this idea when creating Humans of Bombay.
 
• The correct answer is option 4.

 

**Correct sentence**: *Eig**ht* years ago, she founded **Humans of Bombay, inspired by**__ the single idea - we all want to be heard.
